data.one_liner: Set of Dart extensions for daily use to increase development velocity.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of useful Dart extensions for strings, numbers, datetime, and other common types. It helps reduce boilerplate code for everyday operations.
use_when: You want quick helper extensions for strings, numbers, and dates
You want to avoid writing common utility functions repeatedly
avoid_when: You already have your own preferred set of core extension methods
You only need a single lightweight extension and prefer not to add external dependencies
strengths: Covers a wide variety of common types like String, num, and DateTime
weaknesses: Limited documentation of all individual extension methods in the README
No code generation or specialized domain features
